# P6: A later start gave more sleep but not better grades

Citation: Lindqvist, S., & Boateng, P. (2021). European Journal of Education Policy, 9(3), 112-128.
Type: before-and-after study (n = 1,200 students, two schools)

Abstract: Two schools moved their start from 08:30 to 09:15. Students slept 25 minutes longer on school nights. Average grades did not change over the following year.

My notes: Only two schools and no comparison group.
